maxillary_keypoint_topology.keypoint_spatial_matrix: The keypoints in the uppermost row are vertically offset from the dense secondary row by approximately 1.5 times the diameter of a single vibrissa spot, maintaining a parallel horizontal alignment.

rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: The rhinarium exhibits approximately 85-90% melanin saturation, with dark pixels covering most of the surface area except for a localized cluster of lighter pinkish-grey pixels on the central-right apex.

other_distinctive_markers: Unique mottled pigmentation pattern on the nose pad where dark spots overlap with lighter-toned dermal tissue.
